'''Maneros''' was a bald<ref name="TOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, they worked selling [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] from a stall in the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]]. Maneros wore [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and made use of a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] while at their stall, which was exposed to Quesh's toxic [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. They had green skin and an orange [[Eye/Legends|eye]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maneros first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game, they serve as a Republic stims vendor on the planet Quesh.<ref name="TOR" />
